operations.text: 0.3.4 hardens the plan-readiness blocker contract so that INFO is actually used: the shipped readiness brief (templates/briefs/readiness-codex.md) now says in one line that wording, formatting and file:line precision are INFO, never BLOCKER, gives the one test for a row (executed exactly as written, would a ticket fail, land wrong or leave a decision open?) and six INFO examples; docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md carries the same test in one sentence. Nothing in your installation is rewritten by this update: the brief is read from the payload at every pass.
